hemp_string.name: Hemp String Wristband
hemp_string.note: Astrals can now hack through tangled fairy lights.

quartz.name: Quartz Wristband
quartz.note: A blacklight pulse now lights up dark places.

wonky_keychain.name: Wonky Keychain
wonky_keychain.note: Subwoofers and passed-out wooks can now be shoved.

extra_cheese.name: Extra Cheese Stamp
extra_cheese.note: You can now float across foam pits and shallows.

uv_skeleton.name: UV Skeleton Band
uv_skeleton.note: Padlocked VIP fences can now be chewed through.

vip_press.name: VIP Press Pass
vip_press.note: Tuk-tuks will now take you to any Chai Tent you have visited.

ash_mark.name: Ash Mark
ash_mark.note: Banyan roots on the cliffs can now be climbed.

all_access.name: All-Access Hologram
all_access.note: The Mainstage Temple will let you in.

encounters._comment: Wild encounters fill a meter by the zone's encounterRate per grass step; the next one comes when it passes 1 +/- spread, and never sooner than minSteps.

intox._comment: Bands of intoxication (0..1). The higher band applies from its min. See src/core/intox.js.

bands.name: Microdose
bands.down: You are back to a microdose. The world is flat and polite again.

bands.name: Come-up
bands.up: You are coming up. Wild Astrals feel closer, and every fight teaches a little more.
bands.down: You are coming down to a gentle come-up.

bands.name: Peaking
bands.up: You are peaking. Rare Astrals come out to look at you. So do the strong ones. Your hands are getting unreliable.
bands.down: The peak passes. Somewhere, a rare Astral loses interest.

bands.name: Ego gone
bands.up: Ego gone. Everything is an Astral and every Astral is enormous. Drink some water, or do not.

SECOND_WIND.name: Second Wind
SECOND_WIND.desc: Once a battle, it heals a quarter of its Serotonin when it drops below a third.

OVERDRIVE.name: Overdrive
OVERDRIVE.desc: Below a third of its Serotonin, moves of its own type hit 30% harder.

CLEAR_HEAD.name: Clear Head
CLEAR_HEAD.desc: Cannot fall into a Thought Loop or a K-hole.

DREAMER.name: Dreamer
DREAMER.desc: Drifts out of the way of one attack in seven.

STAMINA.name: Stamina
STAMINA.desc: Every move costs one less Hydration.

STATIC_CLING.name: Static Cling
STATIC_CLING.desc: A physical hit on it can leave the attacker with Cottonmouth.

GROUNDED.name: Grounded
GROUNDED.desc: Critical hits never land on it.

BURST.name: Burst
BURST.desc: Its first move after coming out hits twice as hard. Then it pops.

MIRROR.name: Mirror
MIRROR.desc: Copies the first move used on it, for the rest of the battle.

boredom._comment: Standing still on the map this long with the blotter in your bag, you lick it out of boredom: dose added, unless you are already at the ceiling.

timetable._comment: The festival timetable (IMPROVEMENTS point 2, src/core/timetable.js). Banyan brings it after unlockBands wristbands. Minutes on the festival clock; to may wrap past midnight.

sets.name: Sunrise set
sets.what: A slow, beautiful set as the sun comes up over the water. Banyan never misses it.

sets.name: Ecstatic dance
sets.what: Svetlana's morning session: gongs, bare feet and a lot of breathing. Calm Astrals drift in.

sets.name: Night market
sets.what: The market stays open into the dark. A night vendor sells things nobody sells by day.

sets.name: Sponsored sunset
sets.what: Chloe livestreams the sunset to her followers. Everybody faces the sea, and the phones.

sets.name: Diabolo headline set
sets.what: The Pit is packed and the strobes go wild. The only time Diabolo takes on a rematch.

sets.name: Darkpsy hour
sets.what: Fog, UV and 200 BPM. The forest's night things come out to dance.

sets.name: The 5 AM rush
sets.what: Every wrecked raver on the island queues for one of Raju's omelettes. It is always 5 AM.
